```plato
    // True when the coordinate is inside the implicitly closed ring, by an odd
    // crossing count.
    RingContainsCoordinate(self: GeoPath, coordinate: GeoCoordinate): Boolean {
        var ring = self.Coordinates;
        var count = ring.Count;
        var longitude = coordinate.Longitude.Radians;
        var latitude = coordinate.Latitude.Radians;
        return count.Range.Reduce(false, (inside, i) =>
            EdgeCrossesRay(ring[i], ring[(i + 1) % count], longitude, latitude)
                ? inside.Not
                : inside);
    }
```
